lines: Good hands under pressure are rare. Yours helped when the village needed them.
A tool proves itself under strain. So did you.
You were exactly where the defense needed you.
When pressure came down, you did not bend.
The village needed steady hands more than brave words.
You made yourself useful where it mattered most.
I saw the kind of work no bench can teach.
Your work left people alive to notice it.
You held the lane when everyone else needed time to get inside.
I saw you pull a neighbor clear before you went back to fight.
You heard the bell and ran toward the square. I will remember that.
The barricade held because you stayed there with it.
You kept your head when the rest of us were losing ours.
Those doors would have fallen sooner without you.
You gave the wounded enough time to reach shelter.
I watched you choose people over loot. Good choice.
You did not leave when the first line broke.
The golem was not the only one protecting us that day.
I owe you for every tool and every life still in this workshop.
If the bell rings again, I hope you are standing with us.
